GET /api.description: Serves a JSON representation of all available API endpoints.

POST /api/articles.description: Creates an article or private draft. Requires authentication. The author is always the authenticated user. Optional status is published or draft.

GET /api/articles/:article_id.description: Serves the article with the specified ID. Public endpoint. The existing article array response shape is preserved for frontend compatibility.

article.title: Living in the shadow of a great man
article.author: butter_bridge

GET /api/articles/:article_id/comments.description: Serves comments for an article. Public endpoint.

POST /api/articles/:article_id/comments.description: Adds a top-level comment or reply. Requires authentication. Optional parent_comment_id must reference a comment on the same article.

PATCH /api/articles/:article_id.description: Updates an article. Voting uses only inc_votes. Owner content edits may change title, topic, body, article_img_url or status (draft/published). Vote and content fields cannot be mixed.

DELETE /api/comments/:comment_id.description: Deletes a comment. Requires Authorization: Bearer <token> and the authenticated user must own the comment. Returns 204 on success.

GET /api/users.description: Serves public user profiles. Password hashes are never returned. Public endpoint.

GET /api/users/:username.description: Serves a public user profile by username. Public endpoint.

POST /api/users/register.description: Registers a user and returns the public profile plus a bearer token.

POST /api/users/signup.description: Compatibility alias for POST /api/users/register. Password is now required.

POST /api/users/login.description: Authenticates a user and returns the public profile plus a bearer token.

GET /api/users/me.description: Returns the currently authenticated public user profile. Requires Authorization: Bearer <token>.

PATCH /api/users/me.description: Updates the authenticated user's name and/or avatar_url. Requires Authorization: Bearer <token>.

DELETE /api/articles/:article_id.description: Deletes an article and its comments. Requires authentication and article ownership. Returns 204 on success.

POST /api/topics.description: Creates a topic. Requires Authorization: Bearer <token>.

GET /api/articles/:article_id/vote.description: Returns the authenticated user's current vote state for an article. Requires Authorization: Bearer <token>.

GET /api/articles/feed.description: Authenticated personalised feed containing published articles from users the current user follows.

GET /api/articles/drafts.description: Returns the authenticated user's private draft articles.

GET /api/articles/:article_id/manage.description: Returns an article, including drafts, only when the authenticated user owns it.

POST /api/articles/:article_id/save.description: Saves/bookmarks a published article for the authenticated user. Idempotent.

DELETE /api/articles/:article_id/save.description: Removes a saved/bookmarked article for the authenticated user.

GET /api/users/me/activity.description: Returns dashboard stats and recent activity for the authenticated user.

GET /api/users/me/saved.description: Returns the authenticated user's saved published articles.

GET /api/users/me/following.description: Returns public profiles followed by the authenticated user.

POST /api/users/:username/follow.description: Follows another user. Requires authentication and cannot target yourself.

GET /api/users/:username/follow-status.description: Returns whether the authenticated user follows the requested public profile.
